# Worm, phase 2: materials in Cold Light (exact sRGB), the slate bands (each bead's middle ring)
# and undersides, the inner ring caps deleted (hidden inside the beads), joins into five parts
# (Head, Bead0..Bead3), flat shading, export worm.glb. Run after p1_blockout.txt. Generated by make_worm.py.
material new Glow --base-color 0.6980 0.8353 0.8196 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 0.2667 0.3020 0.5176 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.0314 0.0000 0.1216 --no-slot
material new Seed --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
select B0R0
active B0R0
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B0R1
active B0R1
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B0R2
active B0R2
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B0R3
active B0R3
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B0R4
active B0R4
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B0R0 B0R1 B0R2 B0R3 B0R4
active B0R2
join
rename B0R2 Bead0
mode edit
select all
merge --by-distance 0.001
material assign Glow
select face where "abs(pos.y) < 0.0450 || normal.z < -0.6"
material assign Band
mode object
select B1R0
active B1R0
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B1R1
active B1R1
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B1R2
active B1R2
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B1R3
active B1R3
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B1R4
active B1R4
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B1R0 B1R1 B1R2 B1R3 B1R4
active B1R2
join
rename B1R2 Bead1
mode edit
select all
merge --by-distance 0.001
material assign Glow
select face where "abs(pos.y) < 0.0405 || normal.z < -0.6"
material assign Band
mode object
select B2R0
active B2R0
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B2R1
active B2R1
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B2R2
active B2R2
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B2R3
active B2R3
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B2R4
active B2R4
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B2R0 B2R1 B2R2 B2R3 B2R4
active B2R2
join
rename B2R2 Bead2
mode edit
select all
merge --by-distance 0.001
material assign Glow
select face where "abs(pos.y) < 0.0350 || normal.z < -0.6"
material assign Band
mode object
select B3R0
active B3R0
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B3R1
active B3R1
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B3R2
active B3R2
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B3R3
active B3R3
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.y) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B3R4
active B3R4
mode edit
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select B3R0 B3R1 B3R2 B3R3 B3R4
active B3R2
join
rename B3R2 Bead3
mode edit
select all
merge --by-distance 0.001
material assign Glow
select face where "abs(pos.y) < 0.0285 || normal.z < -0.6"
material assign Band
mode object
select Head EyeL EyeR StalkL StalkR BallL BallR Mouth
active Head
join
mode edit
select all
material assign Glow
select face where "normal.z < -0.55"
material assign Band
select face where "pos.y < -0.172"
select linked
material assign Eye
select face where "pos.z > 0.205 && pos.z < 0.25"
select linked
material assign Band
select face where "pos.z > 0.36"
select linked
material assign Glow
mode object
material remove Seed
select all
shade flat
inspect stats
export worm.glb
